title: What she still wants to do
summary: She wants to rise in music for the sake of the poor; the street naming in Kansas City was badly promoted.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: At this point what is it that you want to do that you're not doing, aside from playing classical music?
I'm doing everything I want to do now except there are certain things I want to do, reach, go as high as I can now for the sake of others and not for Mary Lou (or to die, uh.)
Go as high as you can in what sense?

In the music field, I mean reach the pinnacle for public relations and get a lot of things going, because I cannot help the poor if I haven't got any strength in myself or any power to do so. I found that out. I can feed a lot of mouths if I got strength to go to somebody and ask for it. The world is still based on phony things and so what I'm trying to do is to do as many things like - such things as that street being named after me but I think I was cut down a little bit. It didn't leave Kansas City. (LAUGHTER) Isn't that something? The biggest thing that ever happened in the world of music and it was put up on a high level and everything and not one public relations man was there that could spread it all over the world. I've never heard of such a thing. If you were there and saw what went down - I don't think they knew what they were doing or they didn't exploit it right. That was a big deal. That was the biggest deal you ever heard of.
